verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a WebRTC media platform, but nothing in the evidence documents per-session call-quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, or bitrate through a dashboard or API. The closest item (livekit-docs-19) describes resource allocation, latency, errors, and process metrics for deployed agents. That is adjacent agent-observability, not per-session media quality telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
